actor.identifier: current anonymous actor; never a self-asserted user identifier

region.authority: server connection country from a fresh local country database
region.forwarded_headers: only the rightmost entry of the last X-Forwarded-For line from an explicitly trusted socket peer
region.request_reference: must match the server country and retained SOFT_OPT_OUT matrix row; copied advisory fields confer no authority

conditions: server-resolved SOFT_OPT_OUT country matches the submitted advisory reference
existing scope, capability, quota and kill gates pass
all base-contract age, notice and non-objection assertions satisfied

refusals.condition: unknown, strict or mismatching server region
publishable key claims a verified actor
live owner acceptance unavailable or ineligible

receipt_meaning: recording acknowledgement only; no consent grant and no promise of event admission
retries: same bytes and idempotency key; region gate still applies; an original recorded receipt may be acknowledged after acceptance revocation, but event admission requires the original acceptance to remain live
golden_scope: synthetic scope, actor, notice and decision time; retained matrix reference; contract vector, not a runtime capture
